The '''''Childerly''''' was one of two [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]], along with the ''[[Markess Narn]]'', that protected [[Vergesso Base]], one of the largest [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowports]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
